description:
Roman SX (Roman Space Exploration) is a solo-member team. Engineered single-handedly by a 14-year-old NASA's Cosmic Pathfinders participant utilizing industry-standard Python environments.

Roman SX builds an educational Space Mission Design Game about the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope and a Sun–Earth L2 transfer. Players design a launch vehicle under budget, choose the best launch window possible, and fly an interactive ascent where throttle, staging, and communications decide success.
